entries.question: Mere pas mukhyamantri cashless card hai secondary education department ka us se parcha kaise Banega
entries.answer:
Aapke paas Mukhyamantri State Employees Cashless Scheme (Mukhya Mantri Arogya Param Abhiyan / Rajya Karmchari Cashless Chikitsa Yojana) ka card hai, toh KGMU mein iske tahat OPD parcha (registration) banwane ki prakriya yeh hai:

1. **Registration Counter:** KGMU aane par aapko aam nagriko ki tarah ₹50 wali general line mein lagne ki zaroorat nahi hai. KGMU mein aisi cashless/government schemes ke liye alag se desk ya counter ki suvidha hoti hai jahan aap apna Mukhyamantri Cashless Card, aadhar card aur sambandhit vibhag (Secondary Education Department) ka ID card/certificate dikha sakte hain.
2. **Verification:** Counter par aapke card aur documents ka verification kiya jata hai, jiske baad aapka cashless OPD slip (parcha) generate ho jata hai.
3. **Sahyog ke liye:** Agar aapko campus mein iske sahi counter ya window ko dhoondhne mein koi pareshani ho, toh aap madad ke liye KGMU ke **PRO Office** se sampark kar sakte hain (Phone: **9415007710**) ya main helpline par call kar sakte hain (**0522-2258880** / **0522-3539333**).

entries.question: Looking for kyphoplasty surgery
entries.answer:
For information regarding kyphoplasty surgery at KGMU, you should consult the **Department of Orthopedic Surgery**.

For a formal medical evaluation, you are advised to:
1. **Book an OPD Appointment:** Online registration is mandatory. You can book an appointment via [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) or by visiting the KGMU OPD.
2. **Consult a Specialist:** During your consultation, present your symptoms and any relevant imaging (such as X-rays or MRI scans) to the faculty at the Orthopedic department. They will determine if kyphoplasty is the appropriate clinical intervention for your condition.
3. **OPD Details:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50. Please ensure you have a valid referral if you are traveling from outside Lucknow.

**Contact Information:**
*   **Orthopedic Surgery Department:** [View Department Profile](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=22&dept_type=2)
*   **KGMU OPD Helpline:** 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333

*Disclaimer: I am an AI, not a doctor. I cannot provide medical advice or confirm if a specific surgery is suitable for you. Please consult with a qualified specialist at the KGMU Orthopedic OPD for your medical needs.*

entries.question: Mujhe appointment book karna hai nahin ho raha hai call karne per mujhe dant dikhana hai
entries.answer:
KGMU OPD में डेंटल विभाग (दांत दिखाने) के लिए अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करने के कई आसान तरीके उपलब्ध हैं। ऑनलाइन बुकिंग के लिए ऑनलाइन रजिस्ट्रेशन अनिवार्य है:

1. **ऑनलाइन बुकिंग (ORS पोर्टल):** [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाएं, राज्य में 'Uttar Pradesh' और अस्पताल में 'KGMU' चुनें। 'New Appointment' पर क्लिक करके संबंधित डेंटल विभाग, तारीख और समय चुनें, मरीज की जानकारी भरें और ₹50 का ऑनलाइन शुल्क जमा करके पर्ची (slip) डाउनलोड कर लें।
2. **आयुष्मान भारत डिजिटल मिशन (ABHA) ऐप:** ABHA/Health Care App पर मोबाइल नंबर और OTP से रजिस्टर करके इसी प्रकार अस्पताल और विभाग का चयन कर सकते हैं।
3. **एसएमएस (SMS) द्वारा:** अपने मोबाइल से `APPOINTMENT <मरीज का नाम>` लिखकर **8887019134** पर भेजें।
4. **हेल्पलाइन नंबर:** यदि बुकिंग में कठिनाई आ रही है, तो आप KGMU के आधिकारिक नंबर **0522-2258880** या **0522-3539333** पर संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

*ध्यान दें:* OPD पर्ची का शुल्क ₹50 है। शहर से बाहर के मरीजों को संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल (Referral) पत्र लाना अनिवार्य हो सकता है। काउंटर पर भीड़ से बचने के लिए पहले से ऑनलाइन बुकिंग करना सबसे बेहतर रहता है।

entries.question: Appointment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU), online registration is mandatory. You can use any of the following booking methods:

1. **ORS Portal:** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select your department and date, enter patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your appointment slip.
2. **ABHA / Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection flow.
3. **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Visit the hospital with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to complete OTP verification, receive a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip at the counter (counters close at 1:00 PM sharp).

**Important Notes:**
- OPD timings are Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM and Saturday 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (closed on Sundays).
- Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral letter for the specific department.
- For assistance, you can call the helpline at 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333.

entries.question: 5day accidentally patient admit district hospital can admit Kgmu
entries.answer:
Yes, a patient currently admitted to a district hospital can be transferred to King George's Medical University (KGMU) if higher medical care or specialized treatment is required. 

Here are the recommended steps:
1. **Consult the Attending Doctors:** Discuss the need for transfer with the doctors currently treating the patient at the district hospital. They can provide a proper referral note and medical summary.
2. **Emergency and Trauma:** If it is a critical or emergency case (such as severe trauma, cardiac issues, etc.), you can bring the patient directly to the **KGMU Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** or Emergency Department, where emergency services operate 24/7. 
3. **Bring Documentation:** Ensure you carry all medical files, test reports, and the referral letter from the district hospital.
4. **Helpline Support:** For specific transfer queries or guidance, you can contact the KGMU Help Line at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

*Disclaimer: I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.*

entries.question: Cardiology KGMU online oppointment
entries.answer:
To book an online appointment for the Cardiology department at KGMU, you can use the Online Registration System (ORS):

1. Visit the official portal at [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
2. Register or log in using your mobile number.
3. Select **Uttar Pradesh** as the state and choose **King George's Medical University (KGMU)** as the hospital.
4. Select **Cardiology** as the department and choose your preferred available date.
5. Enter the required patient details, pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee online, and download your appointment slip.

**Alternative Booking Methods:**
- **ABHA App / Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same hospital and department selection steps.
- **SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
- **Walk-in:** Visit a physical registration counter at KGMU with your Aadhaar card and active mobile number to collect a token and pay the ₹50 fee.

*Note: Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times. The OPD timing is Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and Saturday, 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM (closed on Sundays).*

entries.question: What is procedure
entries.answer:
To consult a doctor at KGMU, you must have an appointment. Online registration is mandatory. Here is the procedure:

### **Booking Methods**
*   **Online (Recommended):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU. Choose the "New Appointment" option, select the relevant department (e.g., Dermatology), pick a date, enter your patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your appointment slip.
*   **Mobile App:** You can use the ABHA/Health Care App by registering with your mobile number and OTP, then following the same hospital selection flow.
*   **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** You can visit the OPD registration counter with your Aadhaar number and an active mobile number. After OTP verification, you will receive a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and receive your OPD slip.

### **Important Information**
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM. (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Counter Closure:** The ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral from a doctor for the specific department.
*   **Pre-booking:** Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.
*   **Contact/Help:** For further assistance, you may call 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333.

For department details, you can visit the [KGMU Departments page](https://www.kgmu.org/department.php).

entries.question: Appointment kgmu me kaise milegi
entries.answer:
KGMU में OPD अपॉइंटमेंट लेने के लिए ऑनलाइन रजिस्ट्रेशन अनिवार्य है। आप नीचे दिए गए तरीकों में से किसी एक का उपयोग कर सकते हैं:

1. **ORS (Online Registration System):**
   - वेबसाइट [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाएं।
   - राज्य के रूप में 'Uttar Pradesh' और अस्पताल के रूप में 'KGMU' चुनें।
   - 'New Appointment' पर क्लिक करें, विभाग और तारीख चुनें, मरीज का विवरण भरें और ₹50 का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करके पर्ची डाउनलोड करें।

2. **ABHA / Health Care App:**
   - मोबाइल नंबर और OTP के जरिए रजिस्टर करें और इसी तरह अस्पताल का चयन करके अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करें।

3. **एसएमएस (SMS) द्वारा:**
   - अपने मोबाइल से `APPOINTMENT <PATIENT NAME>` लिखकर **8887019134** पर भेजें।

4. **वॉक-इन (Walk-in / अस्पताल आकर):**
   - अपना आधार कार्ड और एक्टिव मोबाइल नंबर लेकर आएं। काउंटर पर OTP के जरिए फिजिकल टोकन लें, ₹50 का शुल्क जमा करें और OPD पर्ची प्राप्त करें।

**महत्वपूर्ण निर्देश:**
- OPD पर्ची का शुल्क ₹50 है।
- शहर से बाहर के मरीजों को संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल (Referral) पत्र लाना अनिवार्य है।
- परची/टिकट काउंटर दोपहर 1:00 बजे बंद हो जाता है।
- समय बचाने के लिए पहले से ऑनलाइन बुकिंग करने की सलाह दी जाती है। 
- अधिक जानकारी के लिए [KGMU ऑफिशियल वेबसाइट](https://www.kgmu.org) पर देख सकते हैं।

entries.question: Appointment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU), online registration is mandatory. The OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods, and pre-booking is strongly recommended. 

Here are the available booking methods:

1. **Online via ORS:** Visit the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh and KGMU, choose your department and date, fill in the patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your slip.
2. **Mobile App:** Use the ABHA or official healthcare mobile app to follow the same hospital selection and booking flow.
3. **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Bring your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to the hospital, generate an OTP for a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee at the counter, and collect your OPD slip. 

*Note: The ticket/parchi counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp. OPD timings are Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM), closed on Sundays. Outside-city patients must bring a valid referral for their specific department.*
